title: Verify: .gitignore and module config path unit tests
summary: Unit test asserts ignore rule and relative config globs
description: Context: .gitignore must ignore game/node_modules/; vitest/tsconfig use relative globs. Desired behavior: tests read these files and assert content. Expected result: pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given .gitignore, when read, then game/node_modules/ is a line and backend/game is absent
Given game/vitest.config.ts and game/tsconfig.json, when read, then they contain tests/**/*.test.ts and "src"/"tests" includes
technical_constraints: Read repo files with node:fs only

steps.action: Read ../../.gitignore relative to import.meta.url with readFileSync, split by newline, assert lines include 'game/node_modules/' and that no line includes 'backend/game'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/config.test.ts

steps.symbol: it('vitest and tsconfig use relative globs')
steps.action: Read vitest.config.ts and tsconfig.json from game/; assert vitest text contains 'tests/**/*.test.ts' and the parsed tsconfig include equals ['src','tests'].
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/config.test.ts
